about_the_game:
Welcome to Acrodrift: FPV Drone Simulator - your launchpad into the electrifying world of first-person drone flight. Designed for both aspiring pilots and seasoned FPV pros, Acrodrift delivers realistic flight physics and immersive gameplay. Whether you’re chasing the thrill of competition or perfecting a smooth freestyle line through tight spaces, this simulator is your aerial playground.

IMMERSIVE CONTROLS

And no matter your setup, Acrodrift adapts to your style. Fly using a gamepad, connect a professional FPV radio controller for authentic handling. The game supports a wide range of devices and lets you remap every axis to suit your preference.

FLIGHT MODES

Start with Free Flight Mode to get a feel for your drone and unleash your creativity as you weave between obstacles and try out gravity-defying stunts. Want a challenge? Race Mode pushes your reflexes to the edge with checkpoint circuits that test your timing and control. More fun-focused? A balloon-popping collection mode is coming soon to add a twist to your training.

DRONE WORKSHOP

Craft your perfect flight machine in the Drone Workshop - customize frames, tweak components, and fine-tune PID settings just like in real FPV gear. Prefer plug-and-play? Prebuilt drones let you dive in without setup worries.

Key Features:

  • Realistic FPV flight with advanced drone physics and customizable PID tuning

  • Multiple gameplay modes: Free Flight, Time Trial Races, and a fun collectible mode

  • Drone customization: Build from scratch or choose ready-made models

  • Controller support: Use gamepads or connect your FPV radio controller for full immersion

  • Beautiful environments in various locations: forests, mountains, harbours, cities!

Whether you're training for real-world races or just love the thrill of virtual acro, Acrodrift is your ticket to sky-high adrenaline.

name: ACRODRIFT: FPV Drone Simulator

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1500X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce RTX 2060 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT (4GB VRAM or more)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: For the best flight experience, we recommend using an RC transmitter. Requirements may change during development
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: A high-speed FPV drone simulator that challenges your skills with precision flying, time attack races, and freestyle exploration. Customize your drone, tune flight dynamics, and master the art of acro flying across immersive environments.
supported_languages:
English*, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Turkish
*languages with full audio support
